title: Dexed
quirks: DX7 32-voice VMEM or single-voice VCED SysEx is converted to the native LV2 parameter ranges.
DX7 algorithm is 0-based in SysEx but 1-based in this LV2 port; operator detune is centered at zero.
Host bank and patch names are retained with complete project parameter snapshots.
Operator pages repeat algorithm/feedback controls to keep each page aligned with eight encoders.
